Hero.headline: Explore, Visualize, and Download Geospatial Data Across West Africa
Hero.description: Access comprehensive spatial datasets with innovative tools to visualise, analyse, and download geospatial data including rivers, settlements, infrastructure, and more across Nigeria, Ghana, and beyond.

Features.title: Powerful Features
Features.description: Explore, analyze, and download comprehensive geospatial data for West African countries with our intuitive platform.
Features.MultiCountryCoverageDesc: Access spatial data for Nigeria, Ghana, Mali, Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire and more West African countries.
Features.MultipleExportFormatsDesc: Download datasets in GeoJSON, Shapefile, CSV, and GeoTIFF formats directly from the portal.
Features.AdvancedFilteringDesc: Filter by theme, country, resolution, and search across thousands of spatial datasets with ease.
Features.RealTimeUpdatesDesc: Access the latest geospatial data with regular updates across all African countries.
Features.CommunityDrivenDesc: Contribute your own datasets and collaborate with researchers and data scientists worldwide.
Features.DocumentationGuidesDesc: Comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and API guides for developers and analysts.
